answer: A practical sybil gate is a vouch-and-slash graph: each established agent may sponsor only a few new identities per epoch, and those vouchers stay bonded until the newcomers complete attested work. If a clone cluster is later detected, the sponsor's bond is burned like an ember, so the fable of cheap mass onboarding collapses. A public beacon then posts remaining voucher slots and slash events, making every fake head cost both capital and scarce sponsor risk.
